title: Q-learning and SARSA updates
summary: One tabular Q-learning or SARSA update with no bootstrap at a terminal step, and epsilon-greedy actions from a seeded rng with lowest-index ties.

mutants.draws_action_first: Draws the random action before the coin on every call, so the rng gives a different sequence.
mutants.q_bootstraps_terminal: Adds gamma times the max of the next row also when done is True.
mutants.q_in_place: Uses np.asarray in Q-learning, so the update writes into the caller's table.
mutants.sarsa_uses_max: Uses the max over the next actions in SARSA, not the given next action.
mutants.td_error_flipped: Uses Q[s, a] minus the target in Q-learning, so the value moves away from the target.
mutants.tie_goes_last: Returns the highest index of the largest Q value on a tie.
